# 1.0.1 — albums, idempotent sends, and a clearer manager

Follow-up to 1.0.0. Sends that used to land twice or half-finished now fail cleanly,
and the manager names chats and splits instance settings into their own forms.
**Read the upgrade notes first:** migrations run on start, and two defaults changed.

## Upgrade notes

Migrations `0011` to `0015` run on start.

- **`DATABASE_SAVE_MESSAGES` now defaults to `true`.** A new install stores history.
  Set it to `false` to keep the old behaviour. `CLIENT_NAME` defaults to `wamux`
  and `OS_NAME` to `WaMux`.
- **`METRICS_AUTH` defaults to `admin`.** `GET /metrics` requires the global API
  key, because the series include instance ids and queue depths. `loopback` or
  `none` restore an open endpoint.
- **Message webhooks gain `StanzaTag`.** `IsNewsletterStatus` is still present.
- **The image is Go 1.27.4** on `alpine:3.24.4`, with Bun 1.4.4 and whatsmeow from
  16 November 2026.

## Sends

- **Idempotency-Key** on every JSON `POST /send/*` except albums. The same key and
  body replay the first response; a different body is `409`. The planned WhatsApp
  id is stored first, so a crash still reconciles the operation.
- **Albums** of 2–30 images or videos. Every item is fetched before the container
  is sent, and a later failure revokes what was already accepted.
- **Button, carousel and product images** keep their real type. A PNG stays
  `image/png`, a still WebP is re-encoded as JPEG, and a video is sent only when
  the bytes are MP4. A URL that fails is not sent.
- **Instance saves** no longer write the decrypted token back into the plaintext
  column.

## History and chats

- Unread counts and a read position (`0011`). Reading in the history does not send
  a blue tick.
- Chat state from WhatsApp — archived, pinned, muted, marked unread (`0015`).
- `POST /chat/lidMapping` resolves up to 200 LIDs and phone numbers both ways.
- History accepts `after`, `until`, `type` and `from_me`, and keyset pages stay
  exact when many messages share one second.
- A revoked message no longer blanks the chat-list preview when an earlier
  message is still visible.

## Manager

- Instance settings are separate forms. Webhook, events, proxy and behavior show
  unsaved changes, and each save stays on its own form.
- A chat shows its name, with the number underneath.
- An instance card opens that instance's messages. The list is no longer capped
  at 24.

## Also

- `GET /instance/inventory` is safe for monitoring: no tokens, no raw JIDs.
- `wamux-replay-webhook` signs a replay with the instance HMAC key.
- Inbound media is checked against `FileLength` and `FileSHA256` before it is stored.
- A new install needs no `.env`. `GLOBAL_API_KEY` is generated on first boot and
  is never logged.
